name: 尖头满钻细跟高跟鞋款
description: 满钻密镶尖头细跟高跟鞋，闪面质感与修长鞋型，宴会婚嫁场景通用

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF and light grey #F2F3F4 panels for packshots and info screens, cool-grey textured stone wall #A7ABAE behind lifestyle and long-shot scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio key from front-left with fill, controlled raking side light for crystal sparkle, soft contact shadows, no harsh blown highlights
styleLock.surfaceSystem: clean white desktop or paper surface #FFFFFF, matte light-grey board #F2F3F4, cool-grey stone wall texture #A7ABAE
styleLock.typography: uppercase geometric sans-serif with wide letterspacing, short headlines and labels in charcoal #3A3D40 or #FFFFFF on the sage panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and small solid triangle pointers in the sage accent, single line weight
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the pair, pointed toes angled forward-left, consistent pair arrangement and scale across the set
noDrift: no readable brand text or logos
styleLock.lockText: consistent elegant sparkle footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light grey info panel #F2F3F4, charcoal text #3A3D40 and one sage-green accent #8FAE9F, with the cool-grey stone wall texture #A7ABAE reserved for lifestyle backgrounds; cool neutral temperature; soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key, fill and soft contact shadows, raking side light only for crystal sparkle; uppercase wide-letterspaced geometric sans-serif headlines and labels; consistent rounded label bars and thin-line icons in the sage accent; clean high-end footwear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 pair angle and stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no readable brand text or logos.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，纯净白底突出满钻鞋面与尖头鞋型
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, full pair visible, pointed toes angled to the lower left
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pair standing upright at a slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, full pair visible with the pointed toes angled to the lower left. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, a soft contact shadow grounding both shoes. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame as a complete centered composition with even margins on all sides. No in-image text anywhere. 8K, commercial fashion e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no feet, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no lens-flare sparkle, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒说清满钻闪面卖点，色块面板建立套图识别度
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, pair placed right of center on a soft paper sheet
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light with gentle fill, delicate crystal sparkle highlights, soft contact shadow
shots.background: white paper surface #FFFFFF with a translucent sage-green panel #8FAE9F covering the left part of the frame
shots.props: one translucent sage-green panel occupying the left side
shots.textZone: 左侧绿色面板内：标题「{callout_1}」与副行「{selling_point_1}」，#FFFFFF 字色
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pair arranged on the right at a slight 3/4 hero angle, resting on a smooth white paper sheet #FFFFFF, with a translucent sage-green panel #8FAE9F covering the left part of the frame. Soft front-left key light with gentle fill, delicate crystal sparkle highlights, a soft contact shadow under the shoes. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, large and dominant on the right while the panel balances the left. Inside the panel place one short headline 「{callout_1}」 and one supporting line 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented material claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no readable brand text.

shots.intent: 放大尖头鞋挤脚、走两步就磨的穿搭痛点，再给出解法
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical camera and crop on both panels, ankle-height framing, no face
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat light conveying pressure; right panel soft diffused light conveying comfort
shots.props: thin-line pressure-mark diagram in #D96A5A on the left panel only
shots.textZone: 左右两格各一条短标签「{callout_1}」/「{callout_2}」，#3A3D40 字色
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen of {product}, two matched panels with identical camera, crop and lighting direction. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: a single plain unbranded pointed pump pressed tight under harsh flat light, with a thin-line pressure-mark diagram in #D96A5A around the toe box, ankle-height framing, no face and no bare skin close-up. Right panel: {product} shown from a matching front angle, toes toward the viewer, in soft diffused light, calm and comfortable. Background light grey #F2F3F4 on both panels, soft top light. Each panel carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3A3D40. The shoe occupies 50-60% per panel, large enough to read the pressure contrast at a glance. Negative: no real model face, no distorted feet, no fused or extra toes, no fabricated statistics, no exaggerated pain, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把婚宴、晚宴的精致氛围感代入，让买家看到自己的场合
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the desktop, pair diagonal across the lower half
shots.lighting: soft diffused daylight from the upper left, 5500K, soft contact shadows, gentle crystal glints
shots.background: clean white desktop #FFFFFF in the lower frame with a cool-grey textured stone wall #A7ABAE filling the upper background
shots.props: a white fur-textured scarf, a closed blank-page magazine with no readable text, and a small mint clutch box with no logo, none covering the shoes
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto a clean white desktop #FFFFFF, with a cool-grey textured stone wall #A7ABAE filling the upper background. Soft diffused daylight from the upper left, 5500K, soft contact shadows and gentle crystal glints. Props: a white fur-textured scarf, a closed blank-page magazine with no readable text, and a small mint clutch box with no logo, none of them covering the shoes. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, the props and stone wall completing a full dressed composition. No in-image text. Negative: no readable magazine text, no brand marks, no hands, no feet, no clutter, no duplicated stone texture, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用密镶钻面与闪粉质地的微距证明做工，打消廉价感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a slight 45-degree overhead angle, very close macro distance, shallow depth of field, foreground facets sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing faceted crystal texture and fine shimmer surface
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Tight zoom on the crystal-encrusted pointed upper, photographed from a slight 45-degree overhead angle at a very close macro distance, shallow depth of field with the foreground facets sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the faceted crystal texture and fine shimmer surface. Matte light-grey board background #F2F3F4. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal even margin, because the crystal texture is the whole point. No in-image text. Negative: no blurry subject, no fake gems, no pasted-on sparkles, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 侧面低角度展示细跟弧度与鞋底衔接，证明鞋型挺括
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle in a clean 90-degree side profile, tight on the stiletto heel curve and the sole edge meeting the upper
shots.lighting: soft directional key from the front with a controlled rim highlight along the heel, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle in a clean 90-degree side profile, tight on the stiletto heel curve and the sole edge meeting the upper. Soft directional key from the front with a controlled rim highlight running down the heel, soft contact shadow on the surface. Seamless light grey background #F2F3F4. The detail occupies 65-75% of the frame as a complete tight composition. No in-image text. Negative: no blurry subject, no warped straight lines, no distorted heel, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用完整的四列尺码对照表消除选码疑虑
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, pair upright in the lower half, table in the upper half
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: light grey #F2F3F4 with sage-green #8FAE9F header bars
shots.props: four-column size table with rounded sage-green header bars
shots.textZone: 上半信息区：行标题「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」，每格填一枚短示例数值
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic size-spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: the pair placed upright in the lower half, and a clean four-column size table in the upper half with rounded sage-green #8FAE9F header bars. Even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background light grey #F2F3F4. Row headers read 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」 in #3A3D40 and every cell holds one short sample numeral so the chart reads as a complete size table. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame with the table and shoe forming one balanced screen. Negative: no fabricated size recommendations, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 同机位同光位对比普通素面与满钻鞋面，让闪面差异一眼可见
shots.camera: two matched panels, identical camera angle, crop and lighting on both sides
shots.lighting: identical soft front-left key light on both panels
shots.textZone: 左右两格各一条短标签「{callout_1}」/「{callout_2}」，#3A3D40 字色
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce side-by-side comparison of {product}, two matched panels with identical framing, camera angle and lighting. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: a plain unbranded heel with a dull smooth matte surface shown at a slight 3/4 angle. Right panel: {product} shown at the same slight 3/4 angle with its crystal-encrusted upper catching soft light. Background light grey #F2F3F4 on both panels, identical soft front-left key light. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3A3D40. The shoe occupies 50-60% per panel so the surface difference is unmistakable. Negative: no fabricated results, no exaggerated claims, no misaligned framing, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 后侧 45° 展示鞋跟与后跟弧线，用可见的做工细节与包装质感建立信任
shots.camera: photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, heel line and back counter visible
shots.lighting: even clean studio light with soft contact shadows
shots.props: two solid rounded sage-green badges #8FAE9F with short white trust labels, and one plain packaging box with no logo
shots.textZone: 右侧两枚实色徽章内各一条短信任标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，#FFFFFF 字色
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pair shown from behind at a 45-degree rear angle so the heel line and back counter stay visible, beside two solid rounded sage-green badges #8FAE9F each carrying one short white trust label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 limited to verifiable care and service points, and one plain packaging box with no logo. Even clean studio light with soft contact shadows, seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with the badges and box completing a full composition. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, quality grades or test data; no fake badges with real-looking seals, no readable packaging text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用成套展示、实色行动按钮与礼遇标签收口促单，不含任何虚构折扣数字
shots.camera: group slight 3/4 front angle with a second arrangement of the same pair slightly behind
shots.lighting: even soft studio light with soft contact shadows
shots.background: sage-green panel #8FAE9F over a white desktop #FFFFFF
shots.props: one solid sage-green CTA button and one solid white offer tag chip
shots.textZone: 底部：标题「{callout_1}」（#FFFFFF）、实色 CTA 按钮「{callout_2}」与实色礼遇标签「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pair shown as a group at a slight 3/4 front angle with a second arrangement of the same pair slightly behind to suggest a set, standing on a white desktop #FFFFFF against a sage-green panel #8FAE9F. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. One solid sage-green #8FAE9F CTA button with a short white label 「{callout_2}」 and one solid white offer tag chip reading 「{callout_3}」, plus a short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF. The group occupies 55-60% of the frame with the button row anchoring the bottom. Negative: no real discount numbers, no countdown timers, no invented offers, no readable member text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张 800x1200 长图切片提炼；已剥离原品牌字、鞋内垫印刷字、杂志英文文字、会员二维码与店铺标识，原始文案与尺码数值统一转为 {callout_n} 短句槽位由商家回填，产品一律以 {product} 占位，鞋身标识交由 {product_identity_lock} 锁定。
